combo_label: Airports × Hot Air Balloons × The Jungle Book

entries.clue: Small breath of smoke or air, or a pastry that rises in flakes
Long dagger of a tooth in a tiger's jaw or a snake's
Gentle side-to-side motion of a load hanging in a light wind
Setting off, as the board of outbound flights announces
Velvet-footed black panther who bought the boy's life with a fresh-killed bull
Families wait here with flowers and hand-written name cards
Go after prey by night, as the law of the pack allows
Long lit strip a jet thunders down before it climbs
It roars out of a cylinder and burns, or it flows to a kitchen hob
Rock serpent of these stories, thirty feet of patient coil
Lame man-eating tiger, sworn foe of the boy the wolves brought up
